title: Government leaders call for treaty negotiations on autonomous weapons for the first time
text: At a New York forum cosponsored by six governments, the ICRC, The Elders and FLI, ministers and UN officials called on states to begin negotiating a legally binding instrument on autonomous weapons at the CCW Review Conference in November.
